library_policy: Original third-party CAD is vendored only when redistribution permission is clear. Otherwise the local parametric model is authoritative for project assembly use.

provenance_summary.notes: The six discovered offerings are HIWIN MGN12H, HIWIN MGN9H, Arduino Mega CAD resources, SycoTec 5045 AC-ER11 STEP, Omron D2F CAD access, and MISUMI 5x8 coupling CAD. No external binary CAD was acquired in this task; every active library entry has a committed project-generated parametric model or provisional envelope.
